title: ClipCraft 1.0 beta 2
summary: A large update to the 1.0 beta: tracked video redaction with review, built-in illustrated Help, keyframes, GIF Studio, webcam picture-in-picture, filters and borders, Preferences, a clearer Library and a simpler ribbon.

Privacy and review: Video redactions follow moving and scrolling text, hold briefly when lost, and flag uncertain moments for review.
Export video lists every tracked redaction that needs review; Show and Previous/Next step through flagged moments.
Detection assists review only. Exported redactions remove the covered content; projects keep the originals.
Video: Recorded cursor with adjustable smoothing, clicks, and zooms that can follow the cursor.
Webcam picture-in-picture that starts with the first screen frame and skips pauses.
Keyframes for position, size and color with Smooth, Linear and Hold; GIF Studio for short loops.
Recording quality and size estimates, edit several clips and zooms at once, Alt+drag to copy a clip frame.
New video from pictures, with each picture fading into the next; clip color, filters, borders and edges.
Image editing: Ready-made shapes, oval and cloud callouts, and ellipse or freehand blur and pixelate, all as presets.
Perspective for image objects, filters, color, borders and edges, crop ratios, Cut Out edges and a hard-edged Eraser.
Snapping to objects, edges and an optional grid; color palettes; watermarks; SVG and EPS import.
ClipCraft Blue is the first preset for every drawing tool; lines and arrows start at thickness 3.
Workspace: Help window with illustrated, searchable articles; press F1 over any control.
Formatting now holds what Advanced had; Preferences (Ctrl+Comma) replaces the Options page.
A clearer Library: labeled sidebar with counts, folders, By app and By website, filter chips and pinning in Recent.
Open and closed hand cursors, tooltips sized to their text, and faster editing on styled images.

limitations: Unsigned Windows 10/11 x64 beta. Old development project formats are unsupported; back up work before updating.

Automatic detection and tracking of sensitive information does not guarantee complete coverage. Review every flagged range and the whole video before sharing. Focus and Magnify are emphasis, not privacy tools; blur and pixelation may leave information inferable.
Framed crossfades involving rotation, transparency or different frames can preview less smoothly than they export.
Scrolling capture is Region-only. By website fills in only when the window title names the site.
Silent startup on some older Windows 11 laptops is still being investigated.
PDF text is outlined, not searchable. No automatic updater.
